==Description==
The '''Battery''' was an item that appeared in [[The Great Finale]] as part of the [[Lunar Overture Event]].

One '''Battery''' was randomly dropped upon an enemy's death. It disappeared after a few minutes if not picked up. There was no limit on how many '''Batteries''' a player could have. When a player disconnected from the server, all the '''Batteries''' they collected will be dropped on to the ground. Ten '''Batteries''' were required to activate a single [[Spotlight]].

==Appearance==
The '''Battery''' had a similar appearance to a real-life battery. It was colored black and orange, with a plus symbol at the top and a minus symbol on the bottom. The '''Battery''' also had a white outline and a white glow.

==Strategy==
*The '''Batteries''' should be picked up as soon as possible as they do not remain on the ground forever and will disappear if not picked up.
*Players should not share '''Batteries''' when collecting. '''Batteries''' should only be picked up by players who are going to use the [[Spotlight]].
